about.metaDescription: Lumen Books is an independent digital bookshop. Learn about our story, our curation and how we work.
about.title: About Lumen Books
about.lede: We are a small, independent bookshop with one idea: good books should be easy to find, easy to buy and easy to keep.

story.title: Our story
story.p1: Lumen Books started as a shared folder of PDFs passed between friends, and a frustration: great titles that were nearly impossible to buy legally, in a format that disappeared the moment you changed device.
story.p2: Today we are a deliberately small catalogue. Every title is read before it is listed. We work directly with authors and independent publishers, and we keep the selection tight rather than chasing volume.
story.p3: There is no subscription here. You buy a book, you own it, and it stays in your account for as long as we exist.

curation.title: Curation over volume
curation.description: A hundred books we believe in beat ten thousand we do not.

fairness.title: Fair to authors
fairness.description: Authors keep the rights to their work and a real share of every sale.

access.title: Access without friction
access.description: No account walls before you buy, no drip campaigns, no dark patterns.

ownership.title: You own what you buy
ownership.description: Lifetime access, re-downloadable, in the format you prefer.

faq.metaDescription: Answers about buying, downloading, formats, refunds and payment on Lumen Books.
faq.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.lede: Everything you might want to know before you buy. If it is not here, send us a message.

format.a: Most titles ship as EPUB (for e-readers, phones and tablets) and PDF (for printing or reading on a computer). Each product page lists exactly which formats are included. If a title is available in both, you get both files.

instant.q: How do I get my books after paying?
instant.a: As soon as PayPal confirms the payment, your download links unlock — on the confirmation page itself, and permanently under My account → Downloads if you have an account, so you can download again on any device, any time.

lostLinks.q: I never received the email, or I lost my links. What now?
lostLinks.a: Open the Get your downloads page and enter your order number with the email address you paid with: your links are generated again on the spot. Each link stays valid for 7 days, and you can create a new one whenever you need it.

paypal.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
paypal.a: PayPal only. You can pay with a PayPal balance, a linked bank account or a card through PayPal. We never receive or store your card details, and all payments are processed in US dollars (USD).

account.q: Do I need an account to buy?
account.a: No — checkout works without one. We do recommend creating an account so your purchases are stored and you can re-download the files later.

devices.q: Can I read on multiple devices?
devices.a: Yes. Your purchase is tied to your account, not to a device. Sign in anywhere and download again — there is no device limit.

refund.a: Because these are digital files that cannot be returned, refunds are only issued when a file is broken, missing or not the title you ordered. If that happens we will replace the file or refund you in full — just contact us with your order number.

refundWindow.q: I bought by mistake, can I get a refund?
refundWindow.a: Digital purchases cannot normally be refunded once the files have been downloaded, so please double-check the title and format before paying. If something is genuinely wrong with your order, we will always look at it.

security.a: Yes. Payments run entirely through PayPal and the browser is redirected to PayPal's servers to approve the transaction. We only receive a confirmation that the payment succeeded — never your card number. Downloads use short-lived signed links.

language.q: Is the site available in other languages?
language.a: Yes. The whole site is available in English, French and Arabic, and our catalogue includes titles in several languages.

invoice.q: Do you issue invoices or receipts?
invoice.a: Yes. PayPal emails your receipt immediately after payment, and we send a confirmation email from Lumen Books containing your order number and download links.

reader.q: Which reader apps do you recommend?
reader.a: Any standards-compliant reader: Apple Books, Kobo, Calibre, Thorium, or the EPUB reader built into your phone. PDFs open in any PDF viewer.

promo.a: Enter the code in your cart before checkout. Valid codes are applied to your subtotal immediately. Each code has its own validity dates and usage limit.

bulk.q: Do you offer bulk or team licences?
bulk.a: Yes, for organisations and educational use. Use the contact form and mention the number of copies you need.

terms.metaDescription: The terms that apply when you buy digital books from Lumen Books.
terms.title: Terms of Sale
terms.intro: These terms govern the purchase of digital books from Lumen Books. By checking out you accept them.

sections.title: 1. Who we are
sections.body: Lumen Books ("the seller", "we") is an independent digital bookshop. We sell downloadable books directly, without any physical shipping. You can reach us at any time through the contact form or by email.

sections.title: 2. What you are buying
sections.body: Each product page lists the exact formats included (EPUB and/or PDF) and the file size. You receive a personal, non-exclusive, non-transferable licence to read the work on your own devices. You may not resell, share, redistribute or publicly post the files, and you may not use them to train machine-learning models.

sections.title: 3. Prices and currency
sections.body: All prices are in US dollars (USD) and may change without notice. Where applicable, taxes or duties are calculated and collected according to the rules that apply to your country at checkout. A price error that is obviously incorrect does not bind us; we will contact you and offer the correct price before capturing the payment.

sections.title: 4. Payment
sections.body: Payment is handled entirely by PayPal. We never receive or store your card number. An order is only considered paid once PayPal has confirmed the transaction to us; your download links unlock at that exact moment, never before.

sections.title: 5. Delivery
sections.body: Delivery is digital and immediate: as soon as the payment is confirmed, the files appear under My account → Downloads (or in the download email). Download links are short-lived signed links; the account, not the link, is what gives you permanent access. We may refuse or reverse a delivery in the rare case of suspected fraud or chargeback abuse.

sections.title: 6. Accounts
sections.body: An account is optional to buy but recommended to keep your purchases. You are responsible for the confidentiality of your credentials and for everything done through your account. You may request the deletion of your account at any time; order records required by accounting law are kept without your personal identifiers where possible.

sections.title: 7. Reviews
sections.body: You may submit a rating and a review for a book you bought. Reviews are moderated before publication: we remove spam, abuse and anything unrelated. We never edit the substance of a review to change its meaning.

sections.title: 8. Intellectual property
sections.body: The titles sold here remain the property of their authors and publishers. Lumen Books holds the distribution rights for the catalogue and owns the storefront, the cover artwork it produced and the editorial descriptions.

sections.title: 9. Availability and liability
sections.body: The shop and the download service are provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis. We work hard to keep them running but cannot guarantee uninterrupted availability. Our liability is limited to the price you paid for the affected order, except where consumer law gives you more protection.

sections.title: 10. Refunds
sections.body: Because these are digital files, refunds follow a dedicated policy: see the Refund Policy page. Mandatory consumer rights remain unaffected.

sections.title: 11. Governing law
sections.body: These terms are governed by the laws applicable to the seller's registered place of business, without excluding the mandatory consumer protections of your country of residence. Where two rules conflict, the one that gives you more protection applies.

sections.title: 12. Changes to these terms
sections.body: We may update this document as the shop evolves. The version published on the day of your purchase is the version that applies to that order.

privacy.metaDescription: How Lumen Books collects, uses and protects your personal data.
privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains what personal data Lumen Books collects, why, and what you can do about it.

sections.title: 1. Who is responsible
sections.body: Lumen Books is the data controller for the data collected through this shop. Questions about this policy go to the email address shown on the contact page.

sections.title: 2. What we collect
sections.body: Account data: your email address and, if you set one, your display name. Order data: order number, email, the titles you bought, the amount, and the PayPal transaction identifier. Technical data: your IP address for rate limiting and fraud prevention, and strictly necessary cookies such as session, cart, language, theme and cookie consent. Newsletter: your email address and your consent date, if you subscribe.

sections.title: 3. What we never collect
sections.body: We never see or store your card or bank details — payments happen on PayPal's servers. We do not build advertising profiles and we do not sell data to anyone.

sections.title: 4. Why we use it
sections.body: To perform the contract: deliver the files, provide the account and the downloads. For our legitimate interests: keeping the shop secure, preventing fraud and abuse, and understanding which pages are useful in aggregate. With your consent: the newsletter and optional anonymous analytics. You can withdraw consent at any time.

sections.title: 5. Who we share it with
sections.body: Supabase (database, authentication and file storage), PayPal (payment processing), Resend (transactional email) and Vercel (hosting). Each of them processes data only to provide its service to us. No other recipient, and no sale.

sections.title: 6. How long we keep it
sections.body: Order and accounting records are kept for the period required by tax and accounting law. Newsletter subscriptions are kept until you unsubscribe. Rate-limiting counters are kept for a few hours. Account data is kept until you request deletion.

sections.title: 7. Your rights
sections.body: You can ask for access to your data, correct it, delete it, export it, object to certain uses, or withdraw a consent. Contact us and we will answer within thirty days. You also have the right to complain to your local data-protection authority.

sections.title: 8. Cookies
sections.body: Strictly necessary cookies (session, cart, security, language, theme, cookie consent) are always active because the shop cannot work without them. Optional anonymous analytics cookies are only set if you accept them in the cookie banner, and the banner lets you change that choice at any time from the footer link.

sections.title: 9. Security
sections.body: The database is protected by row-level security, book files live in a private storage bucket and are served through short-lived signed links, and every sensitive endpoint is rate limited. No system is perfect, but we never treat your data casually.

sections.title: 10. Children
sections.body: The shop is not directed at children under sixteen, and we do not knowingly collect data from them. If you believe a child has given us data, contact us and we will delete it.

sections.title: 11. International transfers
sections.body: Our providers process data in countries other than your own, including the United States. Where required, transfers rely on standard contractual clauses and equivalent safeguards.

sections.title: 12. Changes
sections.body: When this policy changes, the new version is published on this page. Material changes affecting existing customers are announced by email.

refund.metaDescription: When and how refunds are issued for digital book purchases at Lumen Books.
refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.intro: These books are digital files that cannot be returned. That is why refunds here are rare, fast and reserved for real problems.

sections.title: 1. Principle
sections.body: Once a digital file has been downloaded, it cannot be returned or resold, so change-of-mind refunds are not possible. Refunds and replacements are issued when something is genuinely wrong with your order.

sections.title: 2. When you are refunded
sections.body: The file is corrupt or cannot be opened. The download is missing or fails repeatedly. The title you received is not the title you ordered. You were charged twice for the same order. A promo code or pricing error was applied to your order in our favour.

sections.title: 3. What we do first
sections.body: In every case we start by fixing the order: we re-upload the file or send you the correct title. If that is not possible within a reasonable delay, you get a full refund. You do not have to argue for it twice.

sections.title: 4. How to ask
sections.body: Write to us from the email address used for the purchase, with your order number and one or two sentences describing the problem. We answer within two business days.

sections.title: 5. How you are refunded
sections.body: Refunds are sent through PayPal to the original payment method and usually appear on your statement within three to ten business days, depending on your bank. We never refund to a different account, and we never ask for card details.

sections.title: 6. What is not refundable
sections.body: Change of mind after downloading. A device or reader that is not supported, when the formats are listed clearly before purchase. Titles bought at a promotional price you knowingly accepted. Orders placed through resellers we do not control.

sections.title: 7. Chargebacks
sections.body: Please contact us before opening a dispute with PayPal: most chargebacks are faster and simpler to solve directly. Unjustified chargebacks may lead to a restriction of the account.

sections.title: 8. Partial refunds
sections.body: When an order contains several titles and only one of them is defective, we first replace that title. If replacement is impossible, we refund the proportional share of the order.

sections.title: 9. Your statutory rights
sections.body: Nothing in this policy limits the mandatory consumer rights of your country, including the right to a remedy where a digital product is not as described.
